admission.contract: An activated `pcap_compile()` call accepts a filter string and converts it into an optimizer-ready internal `icode` root.
limitations: The public issue does not disclose the reproducer filter text.
This binds admission at the public API, not at a specific caller such as a fuzz target or application.

root.contract: During optimizer initialization, an allocation-failure path frees `opt_state->blocks` before raising an optimizer error, leaving a stale non-NULL pointer in optimizer state for later cleanup.
root.predicate: blocks_freed_in_init.hit && error_path_cleanup.hit && blocks_freed_in_init.blocks_ptr != 0 && error_path_cleanup.blocks_ptr == blocks_freed_in_init.blocks_ptr && blocks_freed_in_init.time < error_path_cleanup.time
limitations: The issue text gives only the cleanup stack, not which `opt_init()` allocation failed.
Other `opt_init()` failure branches free additional state similarly; this contract captures one concrete stale-pointer variant.

target.contract: `opt_cleanup()` consumes the stale `opt_state->blocks` pointer from the optimizer error path and frees that same heap object again.
target.predicate: cleanup_free_blocks.hit && cleanup_free_blocks.blocks_ptr != 0 && cleanup_free_blocks.blocks_ptr == root.blocks_freed_in_init.blocks_ptr && cleanup_free_blocks.time > root.error_path_cleanup.time
limitations: This target binds the double free specifically to the `blocks` member.
If the observed crash came from a different member (`edges`, `levels`, `space`, or `vmap`), this contract would miss that variant even though the pattern is analogous.
